Lauren — looping Ben from Sales Ops since this smells like the usual forward/Outlook render problem we see with Meet URLs. Quick notes: 

- When an invite is forwarded from certain Outlook clients the original event can lose the provider metadata (Meet/Zoom) and Outlook/Exchange will strip interactive RSVP elements.
- Workaround: reissue event with an explicit plain-text Join URL in the description and include an .ics attachment exported from the organizer account (not forwarded).
- If NovusAI prefers Zoom we can create a temporary Zoom meeting (no password), include the link in the body and publish an .ics that contains that URL. That avoids Meet/Sso rejection on their side.

I can generate the Zoom link + new .ics now. Ben — can you confirm the capacity for a 45m demo (we expect 4-6 attendees) and whether we should record?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park\Senior Customer Success Engineer\Redwood Inference
